newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas to raise local fares 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas to raise local fares 2.5 pct.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Tuesday it would raise domestic passenger fares by 2.5 percent on Wednesday due to the recent hike in jet fuel prices.
"It is accurate," a Qantas spokeswoman said in reference to a newspaper report which speculated that such a price rise would take effect shortly.
"Fuel prices have been increasing for quite some time and we have had to absorb those price increases," the spokeswoman said.
"As you can see airlines worldwide are experiencing increases in fares," she said. "We have had to absorb it and now we are going to be able to reclaim some of it."

The spokeswoman said she could not say when or if international passenger fares would be increased but noted that Qantas was a member of the International Air Transport Association which proposed a three percent rise at a meeting in Geneva last week. Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-18090
